channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK says Arctic defence policy covered by 2025 review
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said the UK’s approach to security in the Arctic and High North is now being addressed through the 2025 Strategic Defence Review, rather than through a standalone update of its 2022 High North strategy. The post UK says Arctic defence policy covered by 2025 review first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Scottish Government delay procurement of new ships
item.description: EXCLUSIVE - Scotland’s marine vessel replacement project plans have shifted from a late-2025 expectation to an open-ended “coming years” timeline, with the official notice updated following UK Defence Journal inquiries. The post Scottish Government delay procurement of new ships first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence firms warn Scotland faces critical skills shortages
item.description: Defence industry representatives have warned MPs that Scotland’s defence sector is facing acute skills shortages, with demand for specialist engineers and welders far outstripping current training pipelines and workforce planning. The post Defence firms warn Scotland faces critical skills shortages first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: BAE wins $184m US Marines ACV production contract
item.description: BAE Systems has secured a $184 million full-rate production contract from the US Marine Corps to build more Amphibious Combat Vehicles, expanding the ACV-30 fleet to more than 100 vehicles. The post BAE wins $184m US Marines ACV production contract first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British Ultra heavy-lift drone extends range to 2,000km
item.description: British drone manufacturer Windracers has unveiled a major endurance upgrade for its dual-use ULTRA unmanned aircraft, enabling flights of up to 2,000 kilometres with heavy payloads, strengthening its role across defence, humanitarian and research missions. The post British Ultra heavy-lift drone extends range to 2,000km first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK warns it will act lawfully against Russia shadow fleet
item.description: Ministers say the UK is ready to use sanctions, regulatory action and “interdiction powers” to target Russia’s shadow fleet, after backing the interception of the sanctioned vessel Bella 1 in the North Atlantic. The post UK warns it will act lawfully against Russia shadow fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MP warns Ajax flaws threaten Welsh armoured jobs
item.description: Conservative MP Ben Obese-Jecty warned that ongoing problems with the Ajax armoured vehicle programme risk leaving General Dynamics’ Merthyr Tydfil plant without work. The post MP warns Ajax flaws threaten Welsh armoured jobs first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence industry says Scottish support has been negligible
item.description: Scotland’s defence industry has received negligible public-sector support in Scotland despite delivering billions in economic value and tens of thousands of skilled jobs, MPs were told during a Scottish Affairs Committee evidence session on defence skills and employment. The post Defence industry says Scottish support has been negligible first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: First of four new Scottish ferries handed over
item.description: The first of four new Islay-class ferries has been formally handed over to Caledonian Maritime Assets Limited, marking a key milestone in efforts to renew Scotland’s ferry fleet. The post First of four new Scottish ferries handed over first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence Housing Service set in law under Armed Forces Bill
item.description: Legislation laid before Parliament would create a standalone Defence Housing Service, extend the Armed Forces Covenant across government and trigger what ministers describe as the largest renewal of military housing in a generation. The post Defence Housing Service set in law under Armed Forces Bill first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
